select p.id as id, title, image, is_vip, c.status as status, c.create_time as create_time from favorites f inner join collect c on f.id = c.favorites_id and c.status = 0 and f.id = #{favoritesId} and c.user_id = #{userId} inner join posts p on c.post_id = p.id and p.status = 2
and p.title like concat('%', #{postName}, '%')
order by c.create_time desc
